rev6.release_notes: Fusion add-in: Export tab > Export Model to G-SEND Drawing - one click sends the open design to G-SEND CAD CAM, which opens it as a new part straight into its drawing (front, top, right and iso views). Check (editor right-click) now also runs the program checks - e.g. two Z words on one line - and lists them with their line and operation.

cadcam.release_notes: Mill: Boundary row on 2D Contour / 2D Pocket / Edge Break (the whole tool stays inside); Post window "Also at" G55 G56 ... (Doosan, Brother, Haas VF-2SS posts); those three posts on the Post with list, "(example)" dropped. Turning: Groove Rough and Groove Finish. Simulate: INSERT TRIM POINT (trim up to / from here); Speed slider; right-click Save / Restore Setting; File > Simulate G-code cuts in Rust too; tools drawn their real length and in proportion (drills, end mills, taps); toolpath and Simulate lines half as bold. Right-click a tool > Make default for the op. Tool Library: Milling / Holes boxes, drop-downs show full names. Drawings: D opens Dimension; dimensions on the isometric view. 3D sheet and 3D PDF: G-SEND.IO logo + link, drawing-window mouse, Direct View. Edge Break: a sharp model edge gets the default break. Quick Chamfer lights the edge under the cursor. Mill Face has its own icon. The Browser is now the Work Tree; shorter origin axes; lighter picked highlight; white arrow cursor. G-code import window fits the screen. Chamfer mill keywords.
